extracted.intended_audience: published creative writers seeking NEA Literature Fellowships
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and program description for applying to the National Endowment for the Arts Literature Fellowships, which award $25,000 to published writers in specified genres on a biannual cycle. Covers eligible genres, award purpose, timing, and contact information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award amount
rubrics_metrics.description: The National Endowment for the Arts Literature Fellowships program offers $25,000 grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monetary value of each fellowship award; intended to provide significant support to recipients.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible genres
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellowships are offered in prose (fiction and creative nonfiction) and poetry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program supports work in these specific literary genres. Prose is explicitly defined to include both fiction and creative nonfiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant eligibility — publication requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Grants are to published creative writers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must be published creative writers (the page states 'to published creative writers'), implying prior publication is a requirement for eligibility; further details likely on the Eligibility page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose / intended use of fellowship
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellowships enable the recipients to set aside time for writing, research, travel, and general career advancement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The award is intended to give writers time and resources to focus on their creative work and related professional development activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program cycle / timing
rubrics_metrics.description: This program operates on a two-year cycle with fellowships in prose and poetry available in alternating years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should note which genre is open in a given year because prose and poetry alternate; planning applications must align with the cycle.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual genre announcement (2022 example)
rubrics_metrics.description: In 2022 we are accepting applications in poetry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page provides year-specific information about which genre is accepting applications; applicants should check the current year's announcement to confirm open genres.
